AntigenSummary.description: A compact view of the antigen presented to the immune system.

blocks.description: Number of canonical basic blocks tokenized.

DangerSummary.description: The danger axis: DCA-style fusion of real harm signals.

pamp.description: Aggregate PAMP, danger, and safe signal strengths.

ModelRef.description:
Which trained model produced a result: needed to audit or reproduce
a verdict, since the same file can score differently under another
model.

antigen_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the antigen metric space the model scores in.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the pack payload (packs only).

signer.description: Key id of the pack's trusted signer (signed packs only).

source.description:
`"pack"` for an imported model pack, `"local"` for a model trained
in this agat home.

RecognitionSummary.description: The recognition axis: is this non-self, and whose family is it?

affinity.description: Binding affinity in `[0, 1]` of the strongest binder.

family.description: Identified family, if a family-bearing detector bound.

known_families.description: How many families the memory pool knew at scan time.

recognized.description: Whether any detector bound the antigen (non-self).

secondary_response.description:
Whether the family attribution came from a memory cell (a fast
secondary response).

self_surface_distance.description: Signed distance from the self surface: positive ⇒ outside self.

verdict.description: Compact human label for the recognition outcome.

SampleRef.description: Which sample this result is about.

name.description: Original file name or path, if the scan knew one.

Severity.description:
The fused, actionable severity for a scanned sample.

This is agat's *recommendation*, derived from the two independent
axes (recognition and danger) carried in the same [`ScanResult`].
A consumer that disagrees with the fusion policy can ignore this and
act on the raw axes directly.

Variants are ordered by severity (`Clean < Review < Suspicious <
Malicious`), so `max()` over a batch yields the worst verdict.

oneOf.description: Within self / unrecognized, no notable danger — no action.

A single axis is mild: non-self but low danger (likely
benign-but-unusual), or within-self yet carrying danger signals.
Worth a human glance, not an alarm.

Non-self with ambiguous danger — the two axes neither clearly
agree nor clearly clear it. Triage.

Recognition and danger agree: non-self *and* dangerous.
Investigate now.

Verdict.description:
The fused verdict: agat's one-line recommendation plus the inputs it
was fused from (kept alongside so a consumer never has to re-derive).

policy.description:
Set when an operator policy (an allowlist or denylist entry)
overrode the fused verdict: `"allowlist"` or `"denylist"`. The
recognition and danger axes are still reported unchanged.

summary.description: One-line human explanation of *why* this severity.

description:
The complete, machine-readable outcome of scanning one sample.

Serialize this to JSON for pipelines; render [`verdict`](Self::verdict)
and the two axes for a human.

agat_version.description: The agat version that produced this result.

model.description:
The model that produced this result. Absent only in results
written before this field existed.

schema_version.description:
Schema identifier; always [`SCAN_SCHEMA_VERSION`] when written by
this build.
